visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a pale green, rough-textured mineral specimen placed on a transparent plastic stand inside a dark display box. The lighting is focused and clear, highlighting the crystal's surface. (2) The lighting shifts to long-wave ultraviolet, and the mineral dramatically changes from pale green to a vibrant, glowing golden-orange fluorescence. The surrounding environment remains dark, emphasizing the glow. (3) The light source changes again to short-wave ultraviolet. The mineral now displays a complex mix of bright pink, red, and subtle blue fluorescent patches across its craggy surface. (4) As the ultraviolet light is switched off and normal light returns, the mineral appears a deep purple-pink color. Over the next few seconds, this purple hue visibly fades, returning to its original pale green state. (5) A final close-up shows the transition again from purple back to green, illustrating the mineral's tenebrescence property clearly against the dark background.
